issues.problem: The high stools face their tables but sit roughly 0.6–0.7 m back from the tabletop edges, leaving users too far away to comfortably work or eat at the tables.
issues.fix: Move the stools closer to their respective table edges while preserving room to sit down and get up.

issues.problem: Both collaboration chairs are set over 0.6 m back from their project-table edges, making the pamphlets and work surfaces awkward to reach while seated.
issues.fix: Move each chair toward its project table to provide a comfortable seated working distance.

issues.problem: The side table is isolated from the lounge seating: it is well in front of the north sofa and still too far from the east sofa to function as a convenient place to set down or retrieve items.
issues.fix: Move the side table within easy seated reach of a sofa or the lounge armchair, keeping the notebook on it.
